title: Founder Runtime Approval Application Authority Grant Handoff Acceptance Capture Persistence Store Live Readiness Gate
goal: Model the capture persistence store live approval evidence gate while keeping approval capture, decision persistence, live CRUD, DB/runtime writes, providers, dispatch, mutation, network, and spend blocked.
safetyRules: Do not create DB schemas, migrations, tables, indexes, raw SQL interfaces, or DB/runtime reads or writes in P130.1.

Do not persist acceptance capture, run CRUD actions, capture acceptance, accept handoff, hand off authority, grant authority, activate authority, apply approvals, or record approve/reject decisions in P130.1.
Do not call providers/models, dispatch agents, execute workers/tools, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend.
Do not expose DemoApp, raw JSON/logs/policy dumps, raw SQL, raw table names, raw report paths, internal phase labels outside OS Roadmap, or raw private IDs in primary UX.
Future DB/store subphases require their own implementation-grade plan and explicit allowed files before any local persistence work is changed.
reuseCheck: Reuse shared/resultEnvelope.js for future dry-run envelopes.
Reuse shared/redaction.js and shared/modeGuard.js if runtime-facing metadata needs guardrails.
Reuse os-roadmap/updatePhaseStatus.js patterns when status helpers are needed.
Reuse existing dashboard cards/routes/tests; do not duplicate UI components.
Reuse existing evidence/activity/audit/cost terminology; do not create new appenders in P130.1.
Reuse P129 capture persistence store metadata, repository intent, migration preview, safe dry-run, and scoped Command Center readiness evidence.
commandCenterUx: P130.1 does not change dashboard source. P129.6 scoped store readiness remains visible only on Business Build and Agent Flow. Chat with NEXUS and Lite stay clean.
costImpact: No provider calls, model calls, network calls, runtime execution, DB writes, deploy/package creation, or provider spend.
